project.description: A small, stable vocabulary of types (Opening, Serial, SerialFormatException, FactoryException, Base64_32, Digest, Digests) that tend to appear in the public API signatures of other crums.io projects. Factored out of util-common so that a project whose own public API exposes one of these types doesn't force its downstream consumers to pull in util-common's much larger, more general (and more volatile) grab-bag of utilities.
